description: Day-1 goldens for PRS-001. Cases cover (a) the headline mapping of RCA fix steps to ranked options, (b) catalog-driven mitigation patterns merging in for symptom-driven options RCA may have missed, (c) the safety-first ranking rule (LOW blast radius beats MEDIUM at the top spot), (d) the requires_hitl invariant on every option, and (e) the manual-investigate fallback when nothing matches.

cases.description: RCA proposes restart (medium) + a set_flag fix (low). Catalog adds a circuit-breaker. Expect the set_flag option to win the top spot — safety-first ranking puts LOW blast above MEDIUM.

rca_verdict.root_cause: Kafka consumer lag on payment events; partition rebalance stuck.

ranked_fix_steps.rollback: Flip the flag back to on.

cases.description: RCA diagnoses an external-dependency cause but only suggests a manual fix. Catalog should merge in the fail-open-to-secondary-provider mitigation (LOW blast, set_flag) and place it ahead of the manual step.

rca_verdict.root_cause: External dependency degradation: gateway returning 5xx burst.

ranked_fix_steps.description: Investigate provider status page; raise ticket with vendor.

cases.description: RCA proposes a rollback_deploy (medium blast). Catalog adds another rollback option. Top pick is one of them; both carry blast=medium so confidence breaks the tie.

rca_verdict.root_cause: Memory pressure / OOM kill after recent deploy.

ranked_fix_steps.description: Roll back email service to previous revision.

cases.description: RCA produces a single LOW-blast manual step and the root_cause doesn't match any catalog pattern. The verdict must still be valid (>=1 option) and the top pick comes from RCA.

rca_verdict.root_cause: Image-asset latency under floodgate load test.

ranked_fix_steps.description: Throttle image-asset traffic via CDN config.
ranked_fix_steps.rollback: Revert CDN config to pre-test value.

cases.description: RCA emits a vague top-level fix. The catalog's cart+redis pattern matches and adds a session-flush option — verifies catalog patterns merge cleanly when their keywords match.

rca_verdict.root_cause: Cart sessions backing in valkey/redis showing working-set pressure.

cases.description: Same Kafka-lag RCA in STAGING. The staging env_bonus should slightly favour medium-blast options that would lose in production. Confirms environment-aware ranking is wired.

rca_verdict.root_cause: Kafka consumer lag on payment events.
